caveats: To graduate with a minor in Bioengineering, students must be enrolled in the minor program, complete a minimum total of 18 credits and all of the minor requirements, as well as the requirements of the major program of study; and have attained an average grade point of at least 2.15 in courses taken within the minor For credit transfer, students can transfer a maximum total of 6 credits to the minor program. Courses accepted for transfer credits must normally be at a level equivalent to HKUST courses of 2000-level or above. Out of the total credits required by the minor program, at least 9 credits should be single-counted within the minor and are not used to fulfill any other requirements for graduation except the 120-credit degree Students may use no more than 9 credits earned from courses delivered in online mode, including HKUST self-paced online [SPO] courses and other online credits approved through the University’s credit transfer procedures, to satisfy the graduation requirements of a degree program.
BIEN 4310: The course was last offered in 2021-22 and was deleted subsequently.
ELEC 4830: The course was last offered in 2021-22 and was deleted subsequently.
Elective(s): BIEN 4310, ELEC 4830 are named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so they were left out of this check.
